scenario_definition.oracle_query: Find an existing commercial unit to assess a conversion into a play space / baby parking (hourly childcare) for 15 children, subject to confirmation of the applicable authorization regime in Turin with at least 115 sqm of gross floor area in energy class D or better near parks.

clarifications.I: I am looking for an existing commercial unit.
D: I plan to operate a flexible hourly childcare space or indoor playground for young children while parents run errands.
I intend to assess a conversion into a play space / baby parking (hourly childcare), subject to confirmation of the applicable authorization regime.
clarifications.Cb: I need a property with at least 115 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 15 people.
Ce: A comfortable commercial space with modern climate control, without demanding a specific energy tier.
I prefer a property in energy class D or better.
Cp: Close to public gardens, pedestrian zones, or neighborhood squares where families naturally congregate.

requirements.description: The user is seeking an existing commercial unit.
The user explicitly requires at least 115 sqm of gross floor area.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Commercial activities and similar' AND surface_area >= 115 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
